findings.evidence: The structure fields use only `GroupExtension` and topological/profinite classes, while `ofFactorSet` uses only `FactorSet.Extension.isTopologicalGroup`, `α.groupExtension`, and its continuous maps; `H2` and `ContCohomology` first enter only in the subsequent class declarations.
findings.fix: Move these declarations to `TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/GroupExtension/Profinite.lean`; keep the class map, equivalence setoid, realization theorem, and classification equivalence in `Cohomology.lean`.
findings.issue: `ProfiniteGroupExtension`, `ofFactorSet` (line 560), and `ofFactorSet_toGroupExtension` (line 573) are broadly useful profinite-extension definitions with no cohomological dependency, so placing them in `Cohomology.lean` unnecessarily makes their API depend on continuous cohomology.

summary: The cohomological classification is placed appropriately, but the cohomology-independent profinite-extension API belongs in the earlier profinite extension module.
